title: Debug with Console.WriteLine: Log Inputs, Find the Bug
description:
Code prints 23 instead of 60? One log line shows you why! 🔍

✅ Log your inputs with Console.WriteLine
✅ Run it and see whether the values are right
✅ Fix the wrong operator and run again

Day 4 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 5, Make AI Review Every Pull Request.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #debugging #csharp #ai
comment: Logs or breakpoints: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: log the inputs before the result, so you can tell wrong data from wrong math.
